mapper.select:
select file_id as fileId, /*文件id */ file_type as fileType, /*文件类型 */ file_name as fileName, /*文件名称 */ file_path as filePath, /*文件路径 */ '' as 备注, /*备注*/ TO_CHAR(create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as fileTime /*文件时间 */ from BOK_FILE_INFO where file_type in ('05','07','08')
AND (file_name like '%' || #{fileName} || '%')
and create_time >= to_date(#{fileTimeBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and create_time < to_date(#{fileTimeEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd') + numtodsinterval(1,'day')
